tools.name: find_qibla
tools.description: Get the Qibla direction (the direction Muslims face in prayer, toward the Kaaba in Makkah) for a place: the bearing in degrees clockwise from true north, the compass direction, the magnetic bearing and declination, and the distance to the Kaaba. Use this for any question about the Qibla, the prayer

tools.name: start_quiz
tools.description: Starts one round of the Awwab Knowledge quiz on Islam: five questions in the chosen language, on an optional topic such as the prophets, the Qur'an, the Prophet's life, worship or Islamic history. Use this for a request for an Islamic quiz, test or trivia. Returns the questions and their options wit

tools.name: check_answer
tools.description: Grades one answer from a start_quiz round. Returns whether it is correct, the correct answer, the explanation, its sources and the running score; after the last question it also returns the final score. Each question can be graded once.
